new_model: create a new BaseStrategyModel or BaseStrategyModelV2 from a TrainTask config object
load_base_strategy_model_model_and_args: load a base strategy model and its TrainTask args dict from a checkpoint file
load_base_strategy_model_model: load a base strategy model from a checkpoint path or return a mock model
load_base_strategy_model_model_cached: load a base strategy model in inference mode with LRU caching for repeated use
review_load_model: review the load_model module to understand model construction and checkpoint loading patterns
